From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Alert] CLUSTERED SIGNUPS - BlueWave Labs trial credits issued

Heads-up — automated fraud detector flagged a cluster of self-serve signups that received trial credits this morning for domain bluwavetech.com. Quick summary: 9 accounts created between 08:03-08:11 PDT, same IP block (shared ASN), identical invite token pattern. Token issuance came from the PLG self-serve path and credits auto-applied.

I pulled signup logs and a screenshot of the IP cluster (attached). Initial look suggests either duplicate/bot accounts or a legitimate team mass-signup. Can you triage? If fraud, we should revoke issued credits ASAP and block the token pattern; if legit, expedite manual review so sales can engage.

Attachments: signup_logs_20250315.csv, ip-cluster-screenshot.png

—Rishi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>

Date: Mon, 17 Mar 2025 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Resolution: BlueWave Labs trial credit cluster — REVOKED ON SUSPICIOUS ADDRESSES

Summary/resolution: After review we classify this as mixed — legitimate company interest plus a handful of disposable addresses that match the bot-like pattern. Actions taken: 
- Revoked 4 trial credit grants tied to disposable addresses (IDs in signup_logs_20250315.csv).
- Placed token family 0x7f9* on temporary issuance hold (24h) while infra deploys pattern block.
- Notified billing contact at billing@bluwavetech.com and sent a verification request for PO/finance confirmation.
- Created JIRA-RW-9123 to track follow-up and prevention improvements (rate limiting on invite flows + stronger email heuristics).

Neha: please follow-up with Alex once we get PO/finance confirmation; re-issue credits to validated corporate emails only. Marissa: flag any impact to the customer experience if they ask for faster re-issuance. Dev: recommend we update the PLG rulebook to treat disposable domains and protonmail aliases as high friction for auto-credit issuance.

Attachments: hubspot-activity-1643.pdf

—Rishi
